# CubiQo AI Overview

CubiQo is a conversation-first, voice-first AI assistant designed as a digital private secretary.

It uses color-based operational intent signals (Red, Green, Yellow) to adapt interaction style, voice tone, and intelligence routing without storing conversations or user memory.

CubiQo does not require users to select AI models. It automatically routes tasks to the most suitable intelligence backend.

Core principles:
- Privacy-first (zero conversation retention)
- Voice-first interaction
- Intent-driven orchestration
- Cooperative AI (human + AI working together)
- One interface replacing multiple apps

CubiQo is not a chatbot and not an emotional AI.
CubiQo is an AI orchestration interface focused on action, trust, and privacy.

## Key Features
- Voice-first private AI assistant
- Color-based intent system (Red, Green, Yellow)
- No conversation storage or memory retention
- Automatic intelligence routing
- Bring-Your-Own AI keys supported
- Digital private secretary capabilities
